import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

I'm reading the lead's report so I can publish the canonical version.

Assembling the draft now; then I'll check it with pandoc.

The only differences in the bottom line are the added links and line re-wrapping, and pandoc reports no warnings. Writing the canonical file now (refusing to overwrite) and registering it.

Registered. Now finishing the turn through the SASE final declaration.

I've published the lead's report as the canonical `202611/capture_alias_typing_tips/capture_alias_typing_tips.md` in the research repo and registered it with `sase artifact create`. The host will commit it after this turn ends.

**What I did to the lead's report:**
- **Opening:** the file starts with the title, then a short research-query summary, then the infographic (`capture_alias_typing_tips_infographic.png`, which is beside the report), then `## Bottom line`.
- **Order:** sections follow the questions a reader would ask: is it a good idea, ground truth, requirement adjustments, design, rollout, validation, alternatives, where the reports disagreed, open questions, and the recommended solution. The lead's preamble and its restatement of the request moved to an "About this report" section just above "Sources".
- **Headings:** I removed the hand-written numbers and cleaned up punctuation so the headings can be link targets. I also moved "Where the reports disagreed" to sit after "Alternatives considered".
- **Cross-references:** every "§N" reference now links to the matching section. I added sparing links from the bottom-line bullets to the sections that back them.
- **Wording:** all other lines are the lead's, copied verbatim by script. A check confirmed that every lead line, table cell, URL and both of the lead's own Mermaid figures (Figure 1 and Figure 2) are present unchanged. The bottom line's text is identical to the lead's apart from the added links.

**Diagrams:** the image agent's status was `ready`, and the proposals file names the lead's report as its source.
- **Placed:** `candidate-alias-proof` → `#figure-candidate-alias-proof`. It is byte-identical to the proposal and sits in the bob-cli reverse-check section, directly after the bullet list whose item "The candidate list is not the truth" it illustrates. It has one reference sentence linking to it.
- **Omitted:** none. The file has 3 Mermaid diagrams (the lead's 2 plus this one) and one figure wrapper.

**Links:** the one external URL (the Grossman et al. CHI 2007 PDF) returned 200. pandoc converts the file with no warnings, and every in-document link, including the figure anchor, resolves. No link was unrepairable.
